notes.title: [Update] Dual Guns Are Here! – Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680818/0b73a3a09ee08ddac967d9ad551c1325928fd893.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hello, Survivors!
This is [b]Jebi[/b], CM of the [b]The DeadLine[/b] development team.[/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome to [b]Patch 1.2.0[/b], the update that makes zombies tremble![/p][p][/p][p]This patch brings [b]new dual firearms[/b] and [b]a new language[/b] support.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapons Added[/h2][p][/p][p][i]“The new weapons will help you survive even longer.[/i][/p][p][i]Performance guaranteed by [b]Rotten Apple Company[/b]!”[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]UZK - 18[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]MXR - 30[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Language Support[/h2][p][/p][p][i]“Special thanks to everyone who helped with the Brazilian Portuguese localization.”[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]The DeadLine[/b] now supports [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be back with even more powerful weapons in the next patch.[/p][p]Stay cool this summer and sweep away those zombies![/p]

notes.title: Thank you to all Survivors!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680818/424d0409a01603cfe8b1154985ebac129ce77352.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Hello, Survivors. [/h2][h2]This is Jebi, CM of The DeadLine development team.[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that over 20,000 players have added The DeadLine to their library,
more than 2,000 players have already played the game,
and over 100 players have followed our Steam page.[/p][p][/p][p]As one of the developers, I can truly say this is one of the most rewarding moments.[/p][p][/p][p]Through the screenshots you’ve uploaded and the ever-changing rankings in Infinite Mode,
we’ve felt your passion and support in so many ways.[/p][p][/p][p]Your enthusiastic interest and response have given our development team great motivation
as we prepare for future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Until this final train reaches every survivor around the world,
we will continue sending it out again and again.[/p][p][/p][p]Your survival experiences shape the next chapter of The DeadLine.
[b]If you could share those experiences in a Steam review, we would be incredibly grateful![/b][/p]

notes.title: [Update] Welcome to The DeadLine's first patch – v.1.1.0!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680818/80758a895aa0f4802fabbc8135828c7d798f73f9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Hello Survivors[/h2][p]This is CM [b]Jebi[/b] from the development team of [i]The DeadLine[/i].[/p][p]How’s your summer going with all the zombies around?[/p][p]Welcome to [b]Patch 1.1.0[/b], the very first update for [i]The DeadLine[/i]![/p][p]In this patch, we’ve made some [b]campaign difficulty adjustments[/b] and introduced [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] for a better experience.[/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1][p][/p][p][i]"We’ve seen many survivors getting overwhelmed by zombie hordes during the campaign.[/i][/p][p][i]To help more of you reach City Hall Station, we’re giving you a little boost."[/i][/p][p][/p][h3] Campaign Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Starting chip count: [b]1 → 5[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]A legendary weapon is now granted after completing the tutorial.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h1][p][/p][p][i]"We want to help you save even just a few seconds so you can focus more on surviving."[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Main Menu[/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]skip the intro scene by pressing any button[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu button positions have been adjusted[/b] for better accessibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]It’s time to board the last subway once again, survivors.[/p][p]Head into the horde—[b]and begin your desperate struggle to survive![/b][/p]

notes.title: 📢 The DeadLine is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]In a world overrun by zombies, the last subway carrying you has just departed. At each station, gather materials to power yourself up and equip powerful weapons to break through the zombie hordes. Your destination? A place where your family might still be waiting. But the closer you get, the deadlier the threats become. Survive each stop—one by one—on your way to the end of the line. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for waiting. [/p]

notes.title: [Ended] [Notice] Gameplay Log Collection Notice
notes.notes:
[p]\[Ended]
The collection of gameplay logs has ended.
The collected data will be automatically deleted according to Unity Analytics' retention period.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][b][strike]Hello Players,[/strike][/b][/p][p][strike]This is CM “Cat Box” from [i]The DeadLine[/i] development team.[/strike][/p][p][strike]To improve game quality and the overall player experience, we will be collecting gameplay logs through Unity Analytics as outlined below.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]🗓️ Data Collection Period[/strike][/h3][p][strike]From [b]July 25th[/b] until the end of Unity Analytics' data retention period, gameplay logs will be collected via Unity Analytics.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]🧭 Purpose of Collection[/strike][/h3][list][*][p][strike]To improve game balance[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][strike]To analyze player flow and improve in-game systems[/strike][/p][/*][/list][p][strike]Please refer to the detailed information below. Thank you.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h2][strike]📜 Privacy Policy[/strike][/h2][p][i][strike]The DeadLine[/strike][/i][strike] (hereinafter referred to as "the game") values your personal information and collects and processes user data in accordance with relevant laws and platform policies.
Installing or using the game constitutes your agreement to these terms.[/strike][/p][p][strike]This policy is disclosed via an external link labeled “Privacy Policy” on the bottom-left corner of the game screen.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]1. Information Collected[/strike][/h3][p][strike]1-1. Automatically Collected via Unity Analytics[/strike][/p][p][strike]The game uses Unity Technologies' Unity Analytics SDK to automatically collect the following data:[/strike][/p][list][*][p][b][strike]Steam Account Identifier[/strike][/b][strike]: Internal ID used via Steamworks to distinguish users[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][b][strike]Device Information[/strike][/b][strike]: OS, screen resolution, device model, etc.[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][b][strike]Language and Region[/strike][/b][strike]: System language and IP-based region[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][b][strike]Basic Gameplay Data[/strike][/b][strike]: Session start/end times, click events, etc.[/strike][/p][/*][/list][p][strike]These are collected automatically by Unity Analytics SDK, and the development team cannot personally identify users from this data.[/strike][/p][p][strike]1-2. In-Game Custom Event Logs[/strike][/p][p][strike]During gameplay, specific custom events are logged as defined by the developers:[/strike][/p][p][strike]✅ 1. [b]Overall Progress Data[/b][/strike][/p][list][*][p][strike]Campaign mode progress[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][strike]Campaign clear time[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][strike]Infinite mode progress[/strike][/p][/*][/list][p][strike]✅ 2. [b]Weapon Acquisition Summary[/b][/strike][/p][list][*][p][strike]Total number of weapons obtained[/strike][/p][/*][/list][p][strike]✅ 3. [b]Skill Investment Summary[/b][/strike][/p][list][*][p][strike]Total skill points invested[/strike][/p][/*][/list][p][strike]※ These logs are used solely for gameplay analysis and improvement. No personally identifiable information such as name, email, or contact details is collected.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]2. Purpose of Use[/strike][/h3][p][strike]Collected data is used for the following purposes:[/strike][/p][list][*][p][strike]Bug fixing and improving game stability[/strike][/p][/*][*][p][strike]Analyzing game flow, difficulty, and repetition for user experience optimization[/strike][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][strike]3. Retention Period[/strike][/h3][p][strike]Data is managed on Unity Analytics’ servers and retained for [b]up to 6 months[/b], after which it is automatically deleted.[/strike][/p][p][strike]All data is stored in an anonymized statistical format, making it extremely difficult to track or identify individual users.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]4. Third-Party Sharing & Delegation[/strike][/h3][p][strike]Collected data is not shared externally and is only analyzed through Unity Analytics, operated by Unity Technologies.[/strike][/p][p][strike]All storage and processing are handled automatically on Unity Technologies’ global servers. No separate outsourcing or third-party storage is used.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]5. User Rights[/strike][/h3][p][strike]As the game does [b]not store personally identifiable information[/b], it is [b]not possible to request access, correction, or deletion[/b] of such information.[/strike][/p][p][strike]However, gameplay data such as scores, settings, and progress are stored locally on the user’s device or linked to the platform (e.g., Steam) account. Deletion of this data can be done by resetting local storage or following the platform’s policies.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]6. International Data Transfer[/strike][/h3][p][strike]Gameplay logs are stored on Unity Analytics’ [b]global cloud servers[/b] (e.g., in North America).[/strike][/p][p][strike]Some collected information may be transferred abroad and is protected in accordance with Unity’s Privacy Policy.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][h3][strike]7. Use of Cookies and Tracking Technologies[/strike][/h3][p][strike]This game [b]does not use browser cookies[/b].[/strike][/p][p][strike]However, session and device data may be collected via Unity Analytics SDK solely for gameplay analysis—not for web tracking.[/strike][/p][p][strike]No proprietary tracking system is implemented; all logging is conducted exclusively through Unity Analytics.[/strike][/p][hr][/hr][p][strike]※ Effective Date: [b]July 25, 2025[/b][/strike][/p][p][strike]Thank you.[/strike][/p]
